content.title: Scottie Scheffler majors timeline: Breaking down last major wins and complete history of finishes | Sporting News
content.text: The best golfer in the entire world is Scottie Scheffler. You don't need the OWGR to tell you that.To be considered the best in the world at golf, you not only have to have consistent top-tier finishes at major events, but you also have to have respectable finishes at the other Tour events in between. Scheffler was already a household name, but became a man of the people when he was arrested ahead of that year's PGA Championship due to a miscommunication while driving. He was released in time to make a delayed tee time, and despite that distraction, finished tied for eighth. Many golf fans ran away with the "Free Scottie Scheffler" memes, and he has become an icon of the sport. 📲 Follow The Sporting News on WhatsAppHere is a look at how Scottie Scheffler has done at the four golf majors in his career. Has Scottie Scheffler won a major?Yes! Scheffler won his first major at the 2022 Masters. He donned the iconic green jacket and decided that one wasn't enough. Scheffler also won the 2024 Masters, becoming the 18th golfer in history to ever win at Augusta more than once. In 2025, he won both the PGA Championship and The Open Championship to move within one major of completing the career Grand Slam.YearEventScore2022Masters-102024Masters-112025PGA Championship-112025Open Championship-17MORE: Lowest 72-hole scores in majors historyScottie Scheffler Masters historyYearFinishCourse2020T19Augusta National2021T18Augusta National20221Augusta National2023T10Augusta National20241Augusta National20254Augusta NationalScheffler's first career major was in 2016, but he didn't find his way to the Masters until 2020. He finished tied for 19th and then tied for 18th the following year, before earning his first green jacket in 2022. His 10-under was good enough to edge out runner-up Rory McIlroy by three strokes. When Scheffler won in 2024, it was with an 11-under and a four-stroke lead over runner-up Ludvig Aberg. MORE: Complete timeline of majors won by Rory McIlroyScottie Scheffler PGA Championship historyYearFinishCourse2020T4TPC Harding Park2021T8Kiawah Island Golf Resort2022CUTSouthern Hills Country Club2023T2Oak Hill Country Club2024T8Valhalla Golf Club20251Quail Hollow ClubScheffler has done relatively well at the PGA Championship. Unlike the Masters, this major rotates locations each year, but that hasn't thrown Scheffler off much. Of the six PGA Championships in which he has competed, Scheffler has only missed the cut once. Of the five that he made the cut, he has finished in the top-10 of the leaderboard. Scheffler's biggest performance at the PGA Championship came in 2025. After being 5-under through the first two rounds, he had a 6-under third round to shoot up the leaderboard. Scheffler won by shooting 11-under, which was five strokes better than Harris English, Bryson DeChambeau and Davis Riley. He has finished tied for second and in third place, but in his limited major experience, he has missed the cut more at the U.S. Open than in the other tournaments. His most recent performance at the 2024 U.S. Open was one of the worst in his career, finishing tied for 41st.
